title: 1920s Fashionable Trio Outdoor Portrait, Sepia Snapshot 1923
back_text_transcription:
Sept 16th, 1923
Too bad we left
Ada out.
description: Outdoor snapshot from September 16, 1923, capturing three people in trendy Roaring Twenties attire, featuring a boater hat, drop-waist dresses, and spectator shoes. The handwritten back note humorously remarks on accidentally cropping out a fourth person named Ada.
